name: 46224 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46224 (Indianapolis) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46224 (Indianapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
